name: code-factory-evidence
description: Inspect signed claims and polyglot audit evidence while keeping release decisions human-owned

setup.notice: Eight read-only tools inspect existing local evidence; they cannot run audits, approve, merge or release. Polyglot evidence requires separately configured native workers.
steps: Install factoryline-code-factory 0.50.0 in the environment where Devin runs tools.
Set FACTORY_WORKSPACE_ROOT to that environment's project directory.
Start a new session and ask Devin to list the Code Factory audit rules and inspect a signed claim.
